content: Bounded queue overflow policy is a deliberate choice: block (backpressure, correct when producer can slow down and loss is unacceptable), drop-write/drop-newest (best-effort, discard incoming item), drop-oldest (favor freshest state, correct for live telemetry where old samples are superseded). Durable delivery requires a queue that never drops (block or grow) feeding a writer that flushes to durable storage; best-effort live consumers should use drop-oldest or drop-newest bounded queues so they never block the producer.
